column1: # Description: This file contains the configuration for the LibreILA core.
# G_SAMP_CLK_FREQ: Clock speed of the sampling (probe) domain
# G_AXIL_CLK_FREQ: Clock speed of the AXIS
# G_SAMP_BUFF_DEPTH: Depth of the sampling buffer in samples
# GEN_TYPE: Type of the generated core. It can be one of the following:
#   - 0: The core is generated as a standalone core with AXI4-Lite interface.
#   - 1: The core is generated with a UART interface for communication with the host.
# G_UART_RX_FIFO_DEPTH: Depth of the UART RX FIFO in bytes
# G_UART_TX_FIFO_DEPTH: Depth of the UART TX FIFO in bytes
# G_BAUD_RATE: Baud rate for the UART
